responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the AArch64 atomic and synchronization RTL patterns, including compare-and-swap, exclusive load/store loops, LSE and RCpc forms, atomic loads and stores, fences, barriers, and related expansion hooks. It is the backend pattern layer that aarch64.cc and the generic atomic expansion logic use to choose between LL/SC sequences, LSE instructions, outlined helpers, and memory-order-specific instruction variants.
